text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold bug was found in cli/commands/init.py when initializing into a directory that already has a lockfile.","The bug caused the generated tree to be missing one file, and only occurred for payloads larger than approximately two megabytes.","The root cause was an N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation.","The fix prefetched the relation in a single query and was submitted as PR #1405 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1.","The fix was validated when the nightly rollup matched source counts for 20 days running.","The codebase is Python-based with test coverage in tests/cli/test_init.py."]}
